raw_response:
Answer: A
Reason: The chest X-ray shows marked cardiomegaly and prominent pulmonary arteries with surgical clips/embolization coils, findings consistent with chronic pulmonary arterial hypertension. In this context, the long-standing pressure overload causes right ventricular hypertrophy/dilation (cardiomegaly) and predisposes the pulmonary vasculature to complications like pseudoaneurysm formation.
